light.cuts_why: UNIT NOTE (orchestrator): Pixal3D built the ice antlers as FLAT SLABS / paper panels around thin beams; the sheet draws angular crystalline tines. Every antler / panel face outside the head, ears and crest tuft removed (also from the bake source); boxes placed off renders of the proxy with the antler-blue faces hidden (ears x -0.37..-0.12 / 0.19..0.42, y -0.55..-0.28, z 4.8..5.48; crest x -0.05..0.2, y -1.0..-0.7, z <= 5.15). The ears' own pale backing panels (fused to the ear shells) are left as generated.
light.adds_why: the antlers rebuilt as ONE region (orchestrator opt-in), mirror-symmetric about the head midline x 0.06 (proxy eyes x -0.17 / 0.32, snout 0.06): the sheet's dominant antler (front view image-left + side view near antler: the two views agree on it) traced in sheet px -> stage frame (front x = (u - 188.89) / 100, side y = (u - 952.06) / 100, z = (797.21 - v) / 100; REGS of the first stage-1 run): base (865,295)s inside the head top in front of the ears -> junction front (120,260) / side (815,245) -> a lower tine sweeping forward-down-out to front (47,335) / side (750,330), and three upward tines: tips front (42,144) / side (722,137), front (70,135) / side (777,127), front (105,168) (hidden behind in the side view); radius 0.12-0.15 at the beam tapering to 0.03 at the tips (front-view widths), capsule chains, smooth union k 0.035. The sheet's second (smaller, foreshortened) antler is not built: the rest pose is symmetric.
light.bake_drop_interior_why: the proxy fur soup has buried inner shells (mane spikes over the body): faces with solid on both sides leave the bake source so the cage stays tight (vulture / crystal_canine lesson)
light.ao_why: AO from the watertight low (the fur soup's inner shells black-hole AO rays), ray length 0.6 u so only real crevices darken (vulture lesson)

glow3d.name: antler_ice
glow3d.why: sheet: the ICE ANTLERS carry a subtle frosty glow (icy blue 129,217,251), nothing else glows: faces within r + 0.04 of the rebuilt antler capsules (none inside the head base) -> region antler_ice

yaw.why: v2 (artist 2026-10-17: 'our characters should be symmetrical head turns are done through posing'): best mirror plane per height slab of the v1 low (yaw sweep +-8 deg, plane x sweep): torso z 2.8..3.6 yaw +0.5 x 0.12, z 3.6..4.4 -0.5 x 0.12, torso z 2.8..4.4 0.0 deg x 0.110 (p99 0.101); legs 4..7 deg = the walk stagger (not a turn), head / face -2.5 deg x 0.065 (face p99 0.026: NOT sculpted crooked). The body is NOT turned, only off-centre: deg 0 = one rigid shift of -0.11 u in x puts the body plane on x 0 (mirror p99 0.424 -> 0.320); the repose below works in this frame

rig.spine_why: v2, shifted frame (light.yaw): spine on the body plane x 0 (torso best mirror plane); the neck runs from the chest top (0, -0.5, 4.3) forward-up to the head pivot; the head (with the v1 antlers) sits 0.05 u to -x of the body plane (antler mirror plane x 0.06 - 0.11; face plane x -0.045 at y -1.3, eye midpoint -0.026 at y -0.74), so the head bone runs along x -0.05 (the antlers' own mirror plane, heading -y) and the neck heading carries the head onto x 0 without turning it

chains.name: arm
chains.why: v2, shifted frame, front legs measured on the v1 low (surface-sample leg-column centres, 0.08 u slabs): shoulder inside the coat (z 3.0; column z 2.4: +x 0.434 / -x -0.393), knee (z 1.8: 0.663, 0.06 / -0.549, -0.212), fetlock (z 0.8: 0.742, -0.037 / -0.585, -0.407), hoof centre (z 0.25: 0.78, -0.08 / -0.70, -0.48): the -x front leg is staggered 0.27..0.40 u forward; points = +x, points_R = -x as generated, the repose makes them one mirror pair

chains.name: leg
chains.why: v2, shifted frame, hind legs (hip, stifle z 1.8, hock z 0.8, hoof centre z 0.25): the -x hind leg is staggered 0.11..0.24 u forward

clips.why: PLACEHOLDER (movement + in-game height open in OPEN-QUESTIONS): the kit's idle breathe + a four-leg walk

config._doc: LIGHT finish of the raw Pixal3D proxy (seed 56, forced 3-view front / back / side, sha c254679c). Points: stage-1 frame (hooves at z 0, x1.0045 to the sheet front height), sheet units. v2 (2026-10-17): symmetry pass (light.yaw shift + repose), the floor plate cut; every v1 colour / glow / cut / add kept.

targets.why: artist 2026-10-17: symmetric rest pose; the four legs mirror-symmetric at the mean (no walk stagger), every hoof planted on the floor (after the plate cut the soles sit at z 0.185..0.2)
targets.radius_why: [reach, taper] per bone: the upper bones never grab the belly / coat (0.5 u), the hoof bone reaches the whole splayed hoof fur (0.7 u: a 0.5 reach left the outer hind fur behind, stretch 6.5 offline)

targets.heading: -y
targets.why: the head straight on the midline: the neck yaws its tip from x -0.05 onto x 0 (5.2 deg about the chest top), the head bone is already heading -y (the antler plane), so the head and antlers translate rigidly, unturned (turning the head 2.5 deg to the face's own plane would turn the v1 mirror-built antlers off the midline: face p99 gain 0.018 u vs antler tips 0.06 u)

rigid.why: the face (snout, nostrils, mouth, both eyes, cheeks) moves as ONE rigid body with the head bone
forehead, ears, crest tuft and both v1 ice antlers ride the head bone rigidly (antler adds kept as built)

repose.why: v2 (artist 2026-10-17, symmetric rest pose): the proxy's off-centre body is shifted rigidly (light.yaw, deg 0) and its staggered legs / off-centre head are undone with BONES (proxy_finish_repose), never by mirror-averaging geometry. No tail chain: the sheet draws no tail (rump fur only)

mirror_after.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)

mirror_before.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)

stretch_all.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex

repose.rule: LBS with the contract rig's weights (+ rigid pins), yaw-only straightening (+ lift), applied as rest

stretch_arm_leg.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex

stretch_neck_head.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex

self_intersections.rule: intersecting triangle pairs sharing no vertex (BVH overlap)

mirror_before.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)

mirror_after.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)

floor.rule: stage 1 floored the FEET at z 0; the centring puts the lowest point at 0

facing.rule: shell centroid -> the front-most midline point of the shell (proxy finish default)

mirror.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)
